title: Local quartic-tail force product obstructs the A^(3/4) operator factorization
question: Does the proposed local energy-weighted factorization ||W_L F K^(-3/4)|| remain bounded for the actual quartic Q3 bond tail, or does the cutoff sector leave an unavoidable polynomial power?

model.cutoff_sector: v=0, q>=2L, q_L=v_L=0 for the declared cosine coordinate cutoff
model.local_energy_comparison: K(q,0)>=1+gamma*q^4 on translated compact test packets; a bounded M K^(-3/4) factorization would imply ||M psi||<=C||K^(3/4) psi||

exact_conclusion.lambda_positive: For c>0, lambda>0 and q>=2L, M_L>=lambda^2*q^7/4 while K^(3/4) grows at most as a constant times q^3 on translated fixed-width packets; the ratio grows at least as a positive constant times q^4.
exact_conclusion.lambda_zero_boundary: When lambda=0 the scalar degree is 3 and the A^(3/4) exponent is only critical; this package does not reject that separate quadratic-bond subcase.
exact_conclusion.scope: The no-go rejects only a local operator-norm A^(-3/4) factorization for the quartic tail-force product. It does not reject state-weighted cancellation, a higher graph power, direct projected D/delta-D estimates, or a common QFT dynamics.

adversarial_review.check: The argument is restricted to q>=2L where the declared cosine taper is exactly zero; no asymptotic approximation is used for the cutoff.
The force is the exact partial derivative of the registered quartic bond and the q^7 coefficient is lambda^2/4.

The scalar calculation is promoted only through translated fixed-width Schwartz packets and the implication of a bounded graph factorization; it is not asserted as a pointwise replacement for the kinetic operator.
The lambda=0 quadratic-bond subcase is retained as a separate critical boundary rather than silently included in the quartic no-go.
Only the named local operator-norm route is rejected; modular/state-weighted and direct projected D,delta-D QFT routes remain open.
R298 formalizes the polynomial identity and rational power-count fixtures, not unbounded operator domains or thermodynamic limits.

qft_interface.closed: An exact actual-Q3 scalar tail-sector obstruction to the quartic local operator-norm factorization through A^(-3/4), with the lambda=0 boundary separated.
qft_interface.open: A state-weighted/modular tail estimate, direct projected D and delta-D locality, a common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This is a QFT-facing route no-go only; it supplies no TECT heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner.

next_action: Replace the rejected local operator-norm factorization by a preregistered state-weighted or product-level cancellation estimate, or use a higher graph power only if its thermodynamic constants can be made uniform.
no_overclaim: This package is not a nonexistence theorem for Q3 dynamics, a failure of all energy-weighted topologies, an OS/KMS/GNS result, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, a C6/Sector-A/Pre-A result, a TECT production map or a Clay result.
